prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 1 "Filling valve (internal frost-burst fitting)": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per pc about 52 (80% range 38 to 79); revealed per pc: 48-55 (case 16)
- line 2 "Connection hose": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per pc about 30 (80% range 22 to 45); revealed per pc: 27-33 (case 16)
- line 3 "Senior installer hours": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per hr about 97 (80% range 69 to 131); revealed per hr: >=91 (case 16), so this line (3 hr) about 290 (208 to 393)
- line 5 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 7 of 16 earlier cases, t = 0 in 9; when indemnified t per pc about 77 (80% range 65 to 88); revealed per pc: >=60 (case 16), >=68 (case 18), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), 34-45 (case 23)

items.rationale: Covered under 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9 as fracture damage to a fitting inside the building caused by frost; price per reference case 16 and price prior.
Covered as a connection element renewed with the fractured fitting per 7.1.9; price per reference case 16 and price prior.
Labour for covered repair to affected part (internal fitting), indemnified per 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9; price per reference case 16 and price prior.
Consumables for covered repair are indemnified under 7.1.7(e); however, reference case 16 shows this line type is usually not indemnified (t=0), likely as a non-itemized, ancillary charge.
Attendance for covered repair is indemnified under 7.1.11; price per reference cases 16, 18, 21 and price prior.

Leak location for internal frost-burst fitting is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2, but reference case 16 shows this line type is usually not indemnified (t=0), likely as a separately billed equipment charge.

items.description: Facade frost damage from outdoor freeze-thaw
items.rationale: External render damaged by frost acting from outside is not covered unless the optional peril in 2.1(d) is agreed; the schedule does not show it as agreed, so 3.5 excludes this line.
Removal of failed external render is excluded under 3.5(b) as work on an external surface damaged by frost from without, with the optional peril not agreed.
Renewal of base plaster on external surface is excluded under 3.5(b) as work on an external surface damaged by frost from without, with the optional peril not agreed.

items.description: Premium insulated render system (upgrade on former plain plaster)
items.rationale: Upgrade is not covered per 3.5(d) and 7.1.10, as the principal work (external frost damage) is not covered at all.
Renewal of substrate is excluded under 3.5(b) as work on an external surface damaged by frost from without, with the optional peril not agreed.
Painting of external surface is excluded under 3.5(b) as work on an external surface damaged by frost from without, with the optional peril not agreed.
Work on undamaged elevations is excluded under 7.1.5 and 3.5(a), as it is not repair of an affected part.
Priming of external surface is excluded under 3.5(b) as work on an external surface damaged by frost from without, with the optional peril not agreed.
Labour for excluded work on external surface is not indemnified under 3.5(c) and 7.1.11.
Flat rate for excluded work on external surface is not indemnified under 3.5(c) and 7.1.12.
